name: M2J SEO Toolkit
author: SEO Boost Hosting

sections.description:
M2J SEO Toolkit gives every post and page a real-time SEO score, keeps
an XML sitemap and JSON-LD structured data up to date automatically,
manages 301/302 redirects, pings Google and Bing when you publish, flags
images missing alt text, and shows real Core Web Vitals data for your
homepage — all free, with no locked or limited features.

Included, free

  • On-page SEO analyzer with a live 0-100 score and actionable checklist
  • Custom SEO title, meta description, focus keyword and canonical fields
  • Automatic XML sitemap at /sbh-sitemap.xml
  • JSON-LD schema (Organization, WebSite, BlogPosting, Breadcrumbs)
  • Open Graph and Twitter Card meta
  • 301/302 redirect manager
  • Automatic search engine ping on publish
  • Missing alt text report with bulk editor
  • Core Web Vitals dashboard (LCP, CLS, INP) using real Google data
  • Admin dashboard with your site’s average SEO score

Optional paid add-on

M2J SEO Toolkit Pro is a separate plugin, sold and distributed
primarily from our own site at https://seoboosthosting.com/seo-boost-toolkit
(not on WordPress.org), that adds one-click alt-text generation,
one-click image compression, and one-click page-cache purge. It is not
required for any of the features above and none of this plugin’s
built-in functionality is limited without it.

This plugin is built and maintained by SEO Boost Hosting and is
bundled free with every SEO Boost Hosting WordPress plan, but works
the same way, with the same free features, on any host.

External services

This plugin connects to the following third-party services to provide
some of its features:

Google & Bing sitemap ping

When you publish or update a post or page, this plugin can notify
Google and Bing so your sitemap is recrawled sooner. It sends your
site’s sitemap URL (no other data) to https://www.google.com/ping and
https://www.bing.com/ping at that time. This is on by default and can
be turned off from SEO Toolkit > Settings.

  • Google: Terms of Service, Privacy Policy
  • Microsoft/Bing: Services Agreement, Privacy Statement

Google PageSpeed Insights

The Core Web Vitals screen sends your site’s homepage URL to Google’s
PageSpeed Insights API to fetch performance data (Largest Contentful
Paint, Cumulative Layout Shift, Interaction to Next Paint). This
happens when an administrator opens or refreshes that screen. Results
are cached for 12 hours. No personal data is sent.

  • Google: Terms of Service, Privacy Policy, API documentation
sections.installation:
1. Upload the m2j-seo-toolkit folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Open “M2J SEO Toolkit” in the admin sidebar to see your dashboard.

On SEO Boost Hosting WordPress plans, this plugin is installed and
activated automatically when your hosting account is provisioned — no
manual steps required.
sections.faq:
Does this conflict with Yoast SEO or Rank Math?

The sitemap, schema, and social meta modules automatically detect Yoast
SEO, Rank Math, or All in One SEO and disable themselves to avoid
duplicate output. The on-page analyzer, redirects, image tools, and
Core Web Vitals dashboard keep working alongside any SEO plugin.

Does the plugin ever add links to my site without my permission?

No. The optional “Hosted by SEO Boost Hosting” footer credit is off by
default and only appears if you turn it on yourself in Settings.

Is any feature in this plugin limited or locked?

No. Everything listed under “Included, free” above works fully for
every user, with no license key, trial period, or usage limit. M2J SEO
Toolkit Pro is a completely separate plugin you can optionally buy from
our site — its code is not included here.
sections.changelog:
1.1.1

  • Updated the optional paid add-on references from its old name
    “Auto-Fix Pro” to its current name, M2J SEO Toolkit Pro, and pointed
    the upgrade link to https://seoboosthosting.com/seo-boost-toolkit.

1.1.0

  • Renamed from SEO Boost Toolkit to M2J SEO Toolkit.
  • Removed the in-plugin Pro license/tier system. Core Web Vitals is now
    a free feature for everyone.
  • Removed the alt-text autofill, image compression, and cache purge
    code from this plugin; these are now offered only through the
    separate paid add-on sold on our own site.
  • Documented external services (Google/Bing ping, Google PageSpeed
    Insights) in this readme.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
